youtube_description:
Keeping Up Appearances In My Lada - Visiting The House of Hyacinth Bucket.

A drive around the village of Binley Woods, Coventry to see where Keeping Up Appearances was filmed. As well as visiting The Bucket Residence we also visit Onslow's House! 

For more pictures and videos see Henry's Adventures on Facebook and Instagram!

https://www.facebook.com/Henrys-Adventures-314213162251739/

https://www.instagram.com/henryadventure/?hl=en
